title: Past Simple: regular verbs (-ed)
grammarNote:
Past Simple (Прошедшее простое время) — мы используем его для описания ЗАКОНЧЕННЫХ действий в прошлом. Это действие началось и закончилось в прошлом.

В казахском языке ему соответствует глагол с окончанием -ды/-ді/-ты/-ті (жасады, барды). В русском — прошедшее время (сделала, пошла, позвонила).

📐 Формула для утверждений:
[Подлежащее] + [глагол + -ed]

Примеры из рассказа Aruzhan:
"I CLEANED my room on Saturday." → Я убрала комнату в субботу.
"Yerlan COOKED rice with chicken." → Ерлан приготовил рис с курицей.
"We WALKED to the city park." → Мы прошли до городского парка.
"I LISTENED to music while I cooked." → Я слушала музыку пока готовила.
"Bekzhan STAYED in his room all weekend." → Бекжан остался в комнате на всё выходные.

⭐ ГЛАВНОЕ ПРАВИЛО Past Simple:
Глагол одинаков для ВСЕХ лиц! Нет -s для he/she/it!

Сравни с Present Simple:
✅ Present: "She clean-S her room." (есть -s!)
✅ Past:    "She cleaned her room." (нет -s — только -ed!)

❌ НЕ говори: "She cleane-d-s her room." или "She clean her room last week."
✅ Говори: "She cleaned her room last week."

💡 Слова-сигналы Past Simple (подсказывают что нужно прошедшее время):
yesterday · last weekend / Saturday / week / year · two days ago · on Saturday · in October · that morning · after breakfast · a moment ago

rows.example: "I called my mother on Saturday morning." · "I listened to music." · "I finished the essay section."
"Yerlan cooked dinner." · "Saule bought ice cream." · "Aruzhan painted a watercolour picture."
"We walked to the park." · "We stayed for two hours." · "We watched a film together."
"I cleaned." = "She cleaned." = "They cleaned." → нет разницы в окончании! ✅
❌ "She cooks yesterday." → ✅ "She cooked yesterday." · ❌ "He walks to the park last week." → ✅ "He walked."

grammarExtra.title: ③ Past Simple vs Present Simple — полное сравнение

rows.example: "Aruzhan cleans her room every weekend." (каждые выходные — привычка)

rows.form: Past Simple → конкретный момент в прошлом:
rows.example: "Aruzhan cleaned her room last Saturday." (в прошлую субботу — конкретно)
Past: "He cooked dinner last Friday." → конкретный прошедший момент.
Past: "She studied in the library all afternoon." → закончилось в прошлом.
every day / always → Present Simple ✅ · yesterday / last week / ago → Past Simple ✅
❌ "Yesterday I clean my room." → ✅ "Yesterday I cleaned my room." (-ed обязательно!)
wanted /ˈwɒntɪd/ · visited /ˈvɪzɪtɪd/ · started /ˈstɑːtɪd/ · needed /ˈniːdɪd/ · decided /dɪˈsaɪdɪd/
walked /wɔːkt/ · cooked /kʊkt/ · watched /wɒtʃt/ · finished /ˈfɪnɪʃt/ · talked /tɔːkt/
cleaned /kliːnd/ · called /kɔːld/ · listened /ˈlɪsənd/ · stayed /steɪd/ · enjoyed /ɪnˈdʒɔɪd/
Если слово заканчивается на /t/ или /d/ → слышно /ɪd/. В остальных случаях — /t/ или /d/.
"We walk-ED (/wɔːkt/) to the park." · "I clean-ED (/kliːnd/) my room." · "They visit-ED (/ˈvɪzɪtɪd/) the park."
"walked" = 1 слог (не "walk-ed"!) · "cleaned" = 1 слог · "visited" = 3 слога (/ˈvɪz-ɪ-tɪd/)

grammarTip:
Три шага — и Past Simple всегда правильный:

① Найди слово-сигнал прошедшего времени:
   yesterday · last weekend · ago · on Saturday · in 2023
   Если оно есть → ТОЧНО нужно Past Simple!

② Добавь -ed к глаголу (пока без исключений):
   clean → cleaned · cook → cooked · walk → walked
   listen → listened · call → called · stay → stayed

③ Не добавляй -s — для всех лиц одна форма!
   I cleaned ✅ · She cleaned ✅ · They cleaned ✅
   ❌ She cleane-d-s → ✅ She cleaned

💡 Запомни через Aruzhan:
Last weekend Aruzhan CLEANED her room, COOKED breakfast, CALLED her mother, WALKED to the park, WATCHED a film, HELPED her roommate, LISTENED to a podcast, and PAINTED a picture!
Все 8 глаголов — Past Simple, все с -ed, все одинаковые для любого подлежащего.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct Past Simple form.
exercises.text: Last Saturday, Aruzhan ___ her room from top to bottom.
exercises.hint: "Last Saturday" = past time signal → Past Simple. clean → cleaned ✅ (just add -ed).

exercises.instruction: Write the Past Simple form of the verb.
exercises.text: Yerlan ___ (cook) rice with chicken for his friends on Saturday evening.
exercises.hint: cook → cooked (regular verb, add -ed). No -s for He/She in Past Simple!

exercises.text: "She walked to the park yesterday" and "He walked to the park yesterday" — both are correct.
exercises.hint: In Past Simple, the verb is the same for ALL subjects! I walked · She walked · He walked · They walked ✅

exercises.text: Which sentence uses Past Simple correctly?
opts: Bekzhan stays in his room all last weekend.
Bekzhan stayed in his room all last weekend.
Bekzhan is staying in his room last weekend.
Bekzhan stay in his room last weekend.
exercises.correct: Bekzhan stayed in his room all last weekend.
exercises.hint: "last weekend" → Past Simple needed. stay → stayed ✅. Others use wrong tense forms.

exercises.instruction: Write the correct Past Simple form.
exercises.text: We ___ (walk) to the city park — it ___ (take) about twenty-five minutes on foot.
exercises.hint: walk → walked (regular -ed). "last weekend/afternoon" context → Past Simple.

exercises.instruction: Which word is a signal for Past Simple?
exercises.text: Which word tells you to use Past Simple?
exercises.hint: "last Saturday/week/weekend" → Past Simple ✅. "every day/usually" → Present Simple. "right now" → Present Continuous.

exercises.text: "Yesterday she cooks dinner for everyone" is correct English.
exercises.hint: "Yesterday" = Past Simple signal! → "Yesterday she COOKED dinner." (not "cooks" — that's Present Simple).

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct Past Simple verb.
exercises.text: Aruzhan ___ a small watercolour picture of the river on Sunday evening.
exercises.hint: paint → painted (regular, add -ed). "on Sunday evening" = Past Simple signal. All subjects: I painted · She painted ✅
